name: Vemdalen

seo.title: Vemdalen ski resort guide
seo.description: Three ski areas on one SkiPass in Jämtland: 44 lifts, 62 slopes, 470 metres of vertical and over 155 km of cross-country track.
seo.twitterDescription: 44 lifts, 62 slopes and 470 m of vertical across three areas.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, slope grades per area, where to stay and how to get to Vemdalen in Jämtland, Sweden.

h1: Vemdalen ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Vemdalen is three ski areas on one SkiPass in Jämtland: Vemdalsskalet between two mountains, Björnrike with its own village, and Klövsjö with Storhogna. Together they hold 44 lifts and 62 slopes, the vertical runs to 470 metres, and over 155 kilometres of cross-country track connect them.
stayOverview: The three areas are separate villages, not three sides of one hill. Vemdalsskalet is the liveliest and has the fast lifts; Björnrike is quieter and gentler; Klövsjö and Storhogna share the greenest terrain of the three.
hotelIntro: One SkiPass covers all three areas, so the choice is about which village you want to walk out into in the evening.
rentalCars: A car is useful here: the three areas are separate villages with road between them rather than lifts.

travelTips.title: Which area
travelTips.text: Klövsjö and Storhogna has 15 of its 21 slopes graded very easy or easy; Vemdalsskalet has 13 of 25 graded intermediate or difficult.
travelTips.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Vemdalen lifts, slopes and weather

travelTips.title: One pass, three areas
travelTips.text: The Vemdalen SkiPass covers Vemdalsskalet, Björnrike, Klövsjö and Storhogna.

travelTips.title: Cross-country
travelTips.text: Over 155 kilometres of prepared track, more than any other resort in Sweden's southern mountains.
